text:
maria: heads-up — after the quant-profile v2 rollout last night i'm seeing a spike in eval delta for the regen test set. hallucination rate up ~3.8% and structured JSON outputs have broken fields (missing 'items' array).
aj: thanks. any quick repro or perf traces to look at?
maria: repro is small — `eval/regressions/regen-smoke-2026-03-16`. quick trace shows scheduler picking an fp8 kernel mid-request. snippet: ```KernelScheduler: selected_kernel=fp8_alt reason=latency_estimate(4.2ms) fallback=int8_core latency_int8=3.9ms entropy_init=0.004 calib_version=2026-03-14``` calibration table for fp8_alt looks older than model bundle.
kevin: that entropy_init value is suspicious. we use that to seed stochastic calibration in fp8_alt; small differences can change quantized scales enough to shift logits. seen similar jitter when kernels swap after kv-cache warmup.
shreya: adding telemetry now for kv-cache hit/miss around the token boundary where switch occurs. also logging batch sizes and chosen kernels per-token.
deploy-bot: rolled quant-profile v2 to production (traffic=100%) — triggered at 2026-03-16T23:12:03Z.
aj: quick A/B: if you pin kernel to int8_core for the failing model, does the metric drop back to baseline?
maria: i pinned int8_core on a canary and regen hallucinations returned to baseline. suggest scheduler heuristic is choosing fp8_alt based on avg_seq_len heuristic combined with batching variance.
noah: probable root cause: scheduler uses avg_seq_len > 512 => prefer fp8_alt because estimated throughput higher, but we didn't invalidate per-layer calibration when kernel_selector switches. that causes scale mismatch.
aj: concrete action items: 1) add a calibration-version-check in kernel selector (reject kernel if calib_version mismatch), 2) avoid kernel switching mid-request (only at RPC boundary), 3) run targeted perf+quality sweep across seq_len buckets.
maria: i'll collect eval deltas and structured-diff output. example of schema break: ```expected: {"items": [...]} got: {"item_0": {...}, "_meta": {...}}```
shreya: pushed a quick fix to kernel-steering: no warmup kernel swap for the first 4 tokens and mark kv-cache invalidation when switching kernels. test patch: `git@repo:eng/runtime#patch/kernel-steer-no-mid-swap`
aj: running the suggested smoke script locally: `./scripts/quant_eval.sh --model rdx-small --profile sched,kv,calib --buckets 64,256,1024` sample output: ```bucket=1024 chosen=fp8_alt avg_latency=4.25ms calib_ok=false json_mismatch=1/200```. That json_mismatch correlates with chosen=fp8_alt.
neil: (joining) note: we also saw a tiny rollout step that didn't update the calibration manifest for fp8_alt; metadata checksum mismatch in the release notes. shipping missing checksum will be blocked by CI.
noah: plan: 1) hotfix: block fp8_alt selection if calib_ok=false; 2) backfill calibration table and bump calib_version; 3) run full eval overnight across 10k samples; 4) canary with 5% traffic.
maria: agreed. i'll own the canary and eval collection. aj, can you add observability for per-request kernel history and a flag to force kernel_pin in the console?
aj: will do. adding `kernel_pin` toggle to console feature list + instrument.
shreya: ran a quick smoke after patch — regen-smoke passed locally, no JSON diffs in 500 samples. pushing PR to staging.
maria: thanks. also adding a regression test to eval harness: ensure structured output schema equality under all kernel choices.
noah: one more note — check batching heuristics: if batch coalescing increases avg_seq for the micro-batch, it may push scheduler to prefer fp8_alt. maybe we add a conservative pad-budget penalty for mixed-quant kernels.
aj: good call. adding to RFC for scheduler heuristics.
maria: ok overnight tasks: full eval run, backfill calib table, small canary. i'll post results in this thread tomorrow morning. :coffee: :white_check_mark:
